description: Nearly all dies fail. High anomaly on the TEST EQUIPMENT channel but process sensors are quiet. The wafers may actually be fine.
tests: Cause is the MEASUREMENT SYSTEM, not the wafer. Sharpest test of genuine diagnosis vs relabeled anomaly detection. Must NOT assert a process excursion
demo_use: PRIMARY - use as the 'we handle ambiguity honestly' moment
notes: Constructed scenario, not a real fab incident. SECOM and WM-811K are separate, unrelated datasets - any wafer-map/sensor pairing here is constructed. See PRD Section 9/15.
